name: RC-B10-0248/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Indonesia to investigate two attacks on rights campaigners: Andrie Yunus, hurt with acid, and Muhammad Rosidi, an anti-mining campaigner. It wants independent inquiries, all those responsible tried in civilian courts, and an end to intimidation. It also asks the European Union to raise these concerns with Indonesia and to link trade talks to human rights and environmental protections.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Indonesia to investigate both attacks and end impunity.
- Affects Indonesian rights and environment defenders, and European Union trade and diplomatic work.
- Next: European Union bodies and companies are urged to act; Indonesia is asked to respond.
